description:
General Information
NEW in the Original Packaging
Stocked & Shipped From – LEXINGTON, KY
What is This Part?
This is a COMPLETE SET of OIL SEALS for the Transfer Case Input & Output Shafts.
These Oil Seals Go behind the Drive Shaft Flanges on the Transfer Case.
Includes: Rear Output Shaft Oil Seal, Front Output Shaft Oil Seal and Input Shaft Oil Seal
LOWEST PRICE ON EBAY
Direct Replacement
What Will I Receive?
Qty 1 – Oil Seal (Output Shaft to Rear Differential)
Qty 1 – Oil Seal (Output Shaft to Front Differential)
Qty 1 – Oil Seal (Input Shaft from Transmission)
What Vehicle Will This Fit?
Suzuki Samurai 1985 – 1995 All Models
Suzuki SJ413 1985 – 1995 All Models
